reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No biomarker data available to confirm CD40 engagement by sotigalimab. Without PD/PK data or target engagement biomarkers, cannot confirm the drug reached and modulated CD40. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers or pharmacodynamic markers reported to assess whether CD40 engagement led to downstream immune costimulation. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (ORR) failed across all three cohorts with very low response rates: 9.09%, 7.69%, and 0%. PFS was also poor (1.87-3.48 months). No statistical testing reported. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This was a single-arm Phase 2 trial with no control group, making it difficult to assess true drug effect. The investigator noted termination was a 'business decision (not due to safety reason)' suggesting commercial rather than scientific factors. Multiple serious adverse events were reported but without control arm comparison, their attribution to drug vs disease is unclear.
